opportunities.name: Book unit note (Gutenberg + IMDb adaptation)
opportunities.description: For a given book title, look up its author and download count on Project Gutenberg, find the film adaptation's year and rating on IMDb, and save a 'Unit:' note combining them.
steps: On Gutenberg, click 'Search books', type {book_title}, press Enter
Open the matching book result and read the author and download count
On IMDb, click 'Search IMDb', select all, type {book_title}, press Enter
Open the matching film result and read the release year and rating
In Notes, click 'New note', type 'Unit: {book_title} by {author} ({downloads} downloads). Film: {year}, rated {rating}', press Enter

instances.values: Frankenstein → Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; film 2025, 7.4
Pride and Prejudice → Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; film 2005, 7.8
Treasure Island → Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; film 1990, 7.0 (paused for the Wikipedia Morocco lookup)

opportunities.name: Country geography note (Wikipedia + timeanddate)
opportunities.description: For a given country, get its capital, population, languages and currency from Wikipedia, get the capital's current local time from timeanddate, and save a 'Geography:' note.
steps: On Wikipedia, click 'Search Wikipedia', type {country}, press Enter
Read the capital, population, official languages and currency from the infobox
On timeanddate, click 'Search for city or place…', type {capital}, press Enter
Click the result '{country}, {capital}' and read the current local time and time zone
In Notes, click 'New note', type 'Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop {population}, {languages}, {currency}, time now {time} {tz}', press Enter

instances.values: Vietnam / Hanoi (several retries because of typos in the search box)
Morocco / Rabat (overlaps with the Treasure Island unit)

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for tickets to a given museum and open the top matching tour or ticket listing.
steps: Dismiss the cookie banner if it appears (Reject All)
Click the 'Search for a place or activity' box and select all existing text
Click the most relevant ticket or tour listing in the results

instances.values: Natural History Museum tickets → Field Museum of Natural History Admission Tickets
Louvre tickets → Paris Louvre 6-people Tour with Pre-Reserved Tickets
Rijksmuseum tickets → Rijksmuseum Amsterdam Ticket and Canal Cruise
